To purchase a **Slack subscription** for your team or workspace, you can `choose from their official plans and upgrade directly through your workspace admin settings`.

### **Slack Pricing Tiers** 

- **Free ($0)** : Includes 90-day message history, up to 10 app integrations, and 1:1 huddles.
- **Pro** : ~$7.25 – $8.75 per user/month (annual vs. monthly billing); unlocks unlimited message history, unlimited apps, and group huddles.
- **Business+** : ~$15 – $18 per user/month; adds advanced AI features, SAML-based single sign-on, and SCIM user management.
- **Enterprise+** : Custom pricing for large organizations requiring enterprise-grade security, compliance, and support.[[1]](https://slack.com/pricing)

### **How to Buy / Upgrade** 

1. Log in to your workspace on the [Slack Pricing & Plans Page](https://slack.com/pricing).
2. Select the tier that fits your team size and feature needs (`Pro`, `Business+` , or contact sales for `Enterprise+`).
3. Alternatively, sign in directly to your workspace dashboard at my.slack.com/plans to review or upgrade your current plan.[[1]](https://slack.com/pricing)[[2]](https://slack.com/help/articles/221099048-Upgrade-your-free-workspace-to-a-paid-plan)
